content: {"episode_id":"ep-05035","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0). The monitoring is medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of the current rate and rhythm control strategies, as documented in the ordering clinician's indication note. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial in light of this clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of the service."}
